tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// mkha' 'gro snyan brgyud kyi khrid lugs rgyas pa'i sa bcad bzhugs so//

"$ ༄༅// rdo rje'i chags pa bdo ba'i ku mutta'i// sems dpa' snying rjer zla gzhon gyis 'phrogs pas// dang po'i dus nas snyags kyang bsam rdzogs pa// bcu drug cha las 'byung ba der phyag 'tshal// snyan brgyud rdo rje'i rnal 'byor ma zhes bya ba yid bzhin gyi nor bu rnam pa gsum// mdo rgyud thams cad kyi snying po las snying por gyur pa dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i rtsa bshad kyi gzhung chen po rnams kyi legs par sbyangs pa/ bskal pa bzang po rnams kyis thos bsam gyis rgyal mtshan gyi rtser 'phyar te sgom byung gi mchod pas phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub char du 'bebs pa'i skabs dbye ba la// bsdus rgya gar skad du don gyi dkor sku gsum mdzod gsum bcas tshul/ rgyas bshad kyis de nas yid bzhin nor bu len tshul// gtad rgyas de las 'dod dgu babs pa'i tshul bshad pa gsum las/ gnyis pa la/ ston bslab pa gsum byed slab pa slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid/ bstan dad brtson sa sandhe slob ma'i mtshan nyid/ bstan bya chos kyi gnas lugs bstan pa gsum/ de la phyi sgro 'dogs gcod par byed pa sprul pa sku'i gdams pa brgyud pa yid bzhin gyi nor bu/ nang nyams len longs spyod rdzogs pa sku'i gdams pa smin lam yid bzhin gyi nor bu/ gsang ba ngo sprod chos sku'i gdams pa grol lam yid bzhin nor bu gsum las/ dang po la/ sngon rdo rje 'chang byung ston bde gshegs pa'i rnam thar/ rjes nyes dmigs 'jug sngon rtogs su 'di don bya tshul gnyis/ gnyis pa nang nyams len longs spyod rdzogs pa sku'i gdams ngag smin lam yid bzhin gyi nor bu la/ thabs gtso bor ston pa rdul tshon la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas dbang spyi lugs su bskur ba/ dbang bzhis rgyud/ shes rab gtso bor ston pa sindhu ra yi ge'i dkyil 'khor du zab mo brda'i dbang bskur ba/

dbang don slob dpon bzhi mdud pa'i 'grol tshul gsum/ dang po la/ dngos thog mar 'khor lo bstan rigs thams cad pa'i dkyil 'khor du 'di nyid kyi lugs thun mong ma yin pa'i dbang bskur ba sa'i cho ga rgyas pa dang*/ shugs las bcu gsum ma'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi spyi mthun du bskur ba 'bring dang*/ lus dkyil du dbang bskur ba bsdus pa ste gsum mo// gnyis pa shes rab gtso bor ston pa sindhu ra yi ge'i dkyil 'khor du zab mo brda'i dbang bskur ba la/ dngos lha mo bstan lha mo bco lnga'i sgo nas snyan brgyud brda'i dbang bzhi bskur ba dbang bzhi dang rgyas pa/ shugs las lha bdun ma dang*/ lhan cig skyes ma'i sgo nas byin brlabs 'pho ba'i dbang tsam sbyin pa gsum mo// gsum pa gsang ba ngo sprod chos sku'i gdams ngag grol lam yid bzhin gyi nor bu la/ spros pa smin par can thabs kyi sgo thabs dang nas khrid pa rgyas pa dang*/ spros pa chung ngu shes shes rab shes rab kyi sgo nas khrid pa 'bring dang*/ khrid zin snying po sgril ba zung 'jug gdan zung rdzogs 'brel pa gnyis shin tu bsdus pa gsum las/ dang po la/ bum dbang dbang po smin dang 'brel ba bsgom bya gtso bor ston pa thun mong yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang*/ dbang bzhi ka dang 'brel ba bsrung bya gtso bor ston pa dam tshig yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang*/ mchog dbang dang 'brel ba gnas lugs yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang gsum las/ dang po la/ rgyal po chos dbang po'i nyid mi 'gyur ba/ blon po rigs gsum las byed/ dmangs rnal 'byor phal pa 'phrin las mthun sbyor gyi gdams ngag gsum las/ dang po la/ sbyang tshangs pa'i gzhi mngal skyes sbyong ba'i bskyed rims tshangs pa'i rgyas pa/ sbyang gzhi sgong skyes sbyong ba'i bskyed rims bsdus pa'i 'bring po/ sbyang gzhi rdzus rdzus te skyes sbyong ba'i bskyed rims bsdus pa/

sbyang gzhi phyi rol du 'dzin pa sbyong ba'i zab kun mo bskyed rims/ thams cad la rdzogs rim du sgyur ba'i rtsi bsre bsre ba ro snyoms dbang sogs bshad pa'o// gnyis pa la/ rgyal po rgyal po mnyes par byed pa bdag 'jug lta bu byin rlabs 'jug pa'i gzhi/ rang gi blon po bya ba blon po lta bu dngos grub kyi gzhi/ 'bangs dmangs kyi don byed dmangs kyi pa lta bu bsnyen sogs dag par bya ba'i gzhi/ gsum pa la/ zas 'tshams/ gos/ gnyid nyal/ 'gro 'dug 'gro 'dug khrus khrus/ maṇḍal sogs/ mchod brjod bdun no// gnyis pa dam tshig spyi dang 'brel ba'i srung bya gtso bor ston pa bton pa dam tshig yid kyi bzhin nor bu la/ gzhi zab thub pa'i pa'i dam tshig /lam rgya che sku gsum la ba'i dam tshig /'bras bu zung 'jug gzhi lam gi dam tshig gsum mo// gsum pa mchog dbang dang 'brel ba gnas lugs yid bzhin gyi nor bu la/ gsang dbang dang 'brel ba rdzogs rim rtsa rlung gi gnad steng sgo rnam par grol ba'i chos drug dang*/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang dang 'brel ba mkha' 'gro'i gsang sgrog 'og sgo bde chen dang*/ tshig dbang dang 'brel ba phyag rgya chen po ye shes gsal byed dang*/ lam blo nas chod pa bar do lam khyer dang*/ cig car ba bya spyod tshogs su bsgyur ba'i gdams ngag lnga las// dang po la/ gtum mo bde drod steng 'og bar du rang 'bar/ sgyu lus chos brgyad rang grol/ rmi lam 'khrul pa rang sangs/ 'od gsal ma rig mun bral/ 'pho ba gser 'gyur gyi rtsi/ grong 'jug sbrul lpags 'od zer 'dor len dang drug las// dang po la/ steng rang byung ye shes su sbar nas/ steng rlung gi las ston/ 'og zin dang zag med bde chen 'byung ba du sbar nas 'og sgo'i bcud 'don/ bar nyon mongs rang 'khor 'das rgyun rtsa dang rlung gcod du sbar nas rtsa rlung gi chings ston pa gsum las/ phyi'i gtum

gtum mo mo dbye dang lus gnad/ nang gi gtum mo dbye dang rlung gnad/ gsang ba'i gtum mo dbye dang dmigs gdams pa'i gnad gnad/ de kho na dbye dang gnyid kyi gtum mo dpyid thig gi gnad bzhi'o// gnyis pa la/ rlung skyon sbyor ba'i sbyang ba/ drag srog rtsol rlung gi 'di khri'i tshul pho rlung 'dul ba/ 'jam rtsa ba'i rlung gi rnal 'byor srog mo rlung sbyang ba/ ma rdo rje ning rlung gi rgyun du rdo rje'i bzlas pa bzla ba bzhi'o// gsum pa gsang ba'i gtum mo la// phyi lha'i lha sku stong ra/ nang dhū tī rtsa'i stong ra/ gsang a haṃ ba mi shigs pa'i thig le gsal gdab pa gsum mo// bzhi pa de kho na nyid kyi gtum mo dpyid thig gnad bshad pa la/ dngos 'bar 'dzag sbyor ba lus sbyong*/ gegs bsal ba'o// gnyis pa sgyu lus chos brgyad rang grol la/ gser bogs 'don 'gyur gyi rtsis dman pa rims pa 'di mchog tu bsgyur ba/ nyi zla'i gzugs rnams zer gyis 'phen pa'i ye shes ngo sprad pa/ mnyam pa chags sdang nyid kyi chos brgyad mnyam rjes kyi rgya mdud 'grol ba/ sems kyi skyon sel ba bzhi'o// gsum pa rmi lam 'khrul pa rang sangs la/ dran pa'i mtshan dus lcags kyus 'di dang bzung ba/ brjed bskul gyis sbyang ba/ 'phrin las kyi sgyu mar byin gyis rlabs pa gsum las/ dang po la/ yi dam dran pa'i lcags kyus bzung ba/ bla ma dran pa'i lcags kyus bzung ba/ snang ba dran pa'i lcags kyus bzung ba gsum mo// gnyis pa brjed sbyar dang bskul nyi zla gyis sbyang ba la/ spel zin sbyongs ba/ bsgyur bsgyur ba/ sprul sprul pa/ gegs gegs bsal ba bzhi 'o// gsum pa 'phrin las kyis sgyu mar byin gyis rlabs pa la gsum/ dag pa sgyu mar goms pa sbyang ba dang*/ de kho na cir snang nyid du sgom pa'o// bzhi pa 'od gsal ma rig mun bral la/ gnad khyad par la rmi lam med brten nas sems mal du 'jug pa/

ting nge 'dzin gyis 'od gsal ma bu bsre ba/ lam brjod du khyer rtsal gyi mthar rgyun mi 'chad phyin par bya ba gsum/ gnyis pa la/ nyin mo lam dang rang bzhin gcig tu bsre ba/ mtshan mo lam dang rang bzhin gcig tu bsre ba gnyis/ dang po la dngos rnam rtog dang*/ bsam mi khyab/ gnyis pa la/ sbyor dngos gnyid rjes 'dod chags la gsum mo// lnga pa 'pho ba gser 'gyur gyi rtsi la/ sngon du 'gro ba dus sgo'i gnad/ dngos gzhi 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor// rjes 'pho bas 'bras bu bshad pa gsum/ dang po la/ 'chi ltas 'chi ltas brtag pa/ 'chi ba slu ba bslu ba/ dus kyi shar tshe gnad sgo'i sgo dgu gnad/ bar chad zhen pa kyi mi tshugs pa sogs kyi gnad do// gnyis pa dngos gzhi 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor la/ spros med chos sku'i 'pho ba/ spros bcas gzugs sku'i 'pho ba/ yid 'ong mkha' 'gro'i 'pho ba gsum/ de la sbyang ste 'pho ba lam la bgrod na dang*/ btsan rdzas dang sman nam/ thabs kyi 'pho ba gnyis/ dang po la/ sbyang ba bkag la dang las hūm̐ la sbyar kṣa yig ba gnyis so// drug pa grong 'jug sbrul lpags 'dor len la/ 'jug bya skyon med yul gyi gnad tshad ldan la sbyang ba/ 'jug byed lhag par las sna tshogs don chen sbyor gyi gnad gang 'dod du 'phang ba/ mthun rkyen grogs grogs kyi gnad kyi rnam shes gsos gdab pa dang gsum mo// gnyis pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang dang 'brel ba mkha' 'gro'i gsang sgrog 'og sgo bde chen la/ bstan mkha' 'gro'i bya phyag rgya'i rnam dbye/ bsten tshul mkha' 'gro'i gsang sgrog /bsten 'bras bde chen gyi 'char rim bshad pa gsum las/ dang po la/ rnal 'byor pa rab kyi rdo rje sems dpa'i bud med bsten pa/ 'bring yid kyi rig ma/ tha ma dang po'i las las kyi phyag rgya bsten pa'i tshul gsum/ gnyis pa bstan tshul mkha' 'gro'i gsang sgrog la/ rab rang phyag rgya rig gi gnad zag med rol

kyi bde stong sbyor ba/ chags dang chags/ 'bring zag bcas rtsal sbyong gi gnad kyi bde stong bslab bcas sbyor ba/ tha ma btsan thabs kyi gnad kyi bde stong sbyor ba gsum las/ phyi ma la/ bde tshol skye med kyi sgron ma thig le gtams pa/ rtsa snyen sbyor chos kyi rtsa mdud 'grol ba/ dga' dga' ba bzhi'i dpe bde ba'i nyams don la rtsal sbyor ba gsum/ gnyis pa sbyor chos kyi rtsa mdud 'grol ba la/ dbab cig car dbab pa la mkhas pa rus sbal gyi nur 'gros lta bu/ 'dzin bzung pa la mkhas pa rdzing gi 'ur thur sel gcud khung 'gags pa lta bu/ 'dren bzlog pa glang chen la mkhas pa khron pa'i dpyang rtse gyen du 'dren pa lta bu 'grem bgram pa la mkhas pa sbyor ba mdzangs ma zhing la chu gtong ba lta bu/ bde gnas ba phyag rig mas chen du skyel ba la mkhas pa sprin nam mkhar thim pa lta bu dang lnga'o// gsum pa bsten 'bras bde chen gyi 'char rim pa bshad pa la/ 'dzag lhan skyes med kyi dpe don 'gros dang*/ nyams pa'i nyes bag med dmigs/ dmigs bsal gsang dbang gyi nyes med bshad pa'o// gsum pa tshig dbang dang 'brel ba phyag rgya chen po ye shes gsal byed la/ bsgom pa sprul pa sku'i gnas phyag rgya ngos ye shes gsal byed bzung ba/ bsgom bltas pas byed longs spyod rdzogs pa ye shes lus sku'i bya ba bstan pa/ bsgom bya chos sku phyag rgya chen po'i don bshad pa dang gsum las/ gsum pa bsgom bya chos sku phyag rgya chen po'i don bshad pa la/ lta ba gzhi nas ma bcos pa'i ye shes ngos ye shes bzung*/ bsgom tha mal pa de la ma bcos mig sogs par bzhag pa/ spyod pa snga phyi rol phyi gnyis med du gzhi lam bsre ba/ 'bras sems nyid bu nam mkha' lta bu'i yi ge bzhi 'char tshul bzhi'o// bzhi pa lam blo nas chod pa bar do lam khyer la/ lus bar do ldan mthar ma bzhi'i bar do/ nges nges shes shes rtags

bskyed rim kyi bar do/ ngo ngo sprod sbrod 'bras bu'i bar do gsum/ de la rab sa chu chos sku thug skye shi phrad kyi bar dor 'chi ba lam du khyer ba/ 'bring de lam srid de ma brtags pa spyi lugs kyi bar do blo chod du btang ba/ tha rtsa lnga ma nying mtshams de la brten sbyor ba'i bar dor smon lam gyi 'phen pa bzhag pa gsum mo// lnga pa gcig car ba bya spyod tshogs su bsgyur ba la/ lam spyi'i gdams pa spyi la gegs rtsa ba sel mi mthun/ bya spyod tshogs bsgyur/ 'bras gong rims bu mchog 'khor lo gi dngos grub bshad pa rnam pa rims pa 'di la gsum las/ gnyis pa bya spyod tshogs su bsgyur ba la dbang gi dbang gi gdams ngag /lta bdud ngos bzung bas bdun brtags dbang dus de sgom pa rtags dang sbrel ba/ spyod bya spyod pa gol sa gang dang bcad de tshogs bsgyur 'phrin las dang sbrel ba gsum mo// spros pa chung du shes rab kyi sgo nas khrid pa la/ bsdus/ 'bring*/ rgyas par 'khrid pa la gsum las/ 'bring la bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim gnyis/ dang po la/ rgyal po chos nyid mi 'gyur ba/ blon po'i rigs gsum las byed/ dmangs 'phrin las mthun sbyor/ nye snying gi sgrub pa/ lha mo bco lnga ma/ go cha'i sgrub pa/ lha bdun ma/ snying po'i sgrub pa/ lhan cig skyes ma/ gnyis pa rdzogs rims la/ lta ba gtan la dbab pa thabs kyi nyams su blangs pa'i gdams ngag rtogs pa'i don la sgro 'dogs gcod pa dang*/ rdo rje'i tshig don dkrol ba'i sgo nas zab mo'i don rnam par phye ste snyan brgyud brda'i gdams ngag gi nyams myong rtogs pa'i sgro 'dogs gcod pa dang*/ gnyis su med pa'i don la ngo sprad pa'i sgo nas las dang skal bar ldan pa'i gang zag gi blo'i padma kha phye nas de kho na nyid zhen pa'i sgro 'dogs gcod pa gsum/ dang po la/ dri med ye shes mkha' 'gro ma la mchod par brjod pa dang*/

brda' don ngos bzung ste bstan pa dang*/ de mngon du gyur pa 'bras bu 'char tshul lo// gnyis pa la/ lta sgom spyod pa gsum/ ro snyoms rnam pa gsum/ thabs shes zung 'jug gi brda' rnam pa gsum mo// gnyis pa rdo rje'i tshig don dkrol ba'i sgo nas zab mo'i don rnam par phye ste snyan brgyud brda'i gdams ngag gis nyams myong rtags kyi sgro 'dogs gcod pa la/ gzhi smin par byed pa'i lam/ smin grol sems kyi rgya mdud bshig pa dang*/ dam tshig rang sems me long bstan pa/ dam rdzas rtogs pa'i nyi ma 'debs/ spyod pa chu la ral gri 'debs pa/ rang grol phyag rgya chen po bstan pa/ rtsa rlung drwa mig 'khor lo bskor ba/ rig pa ye shes kyi sgron me bltams pa// ro snyoms phyi'i me long blta ba'o// dang po la/ smin lam dbang gi sems kyi rgya mdud 'grol ba dang*/ grol lam gyi sgo nas sems kyi rgya mdud 'grol ba'o// gnyis pa la/ sgyu ma lus kyi me long la rtsa rlung thig le'i don blta ba/ sems nyid stong pa'i me long la 'od gsal gyi don blta ba/ spros bral don gyi me long la gzung 'dzin gyi dri mas ma gos par bya'o// gsum pa la/ snang ba thabs su rtogs pa dang*/ sems nyid shes rab tu rtogs pa dang*/ bde chen ye shes kyi nyi ma lam du bya ba'o// bzhi pa la/ dbang po tha ma snang ba thabs sgyu ma lta bu'i spyod pa dang*/ 'bring gis snang ba sems su shes pa'i spyod pa dang*/ rab snang ba ye shes su shes pa'i spyod pa'o// lnga pa la thabs kyi nyams su blang ba dang*/ shes rab kyi rang grol ba'i sems ma dang bral ba'o// de'i gnyis pa la/ rtsa ye shes kyi rang bzhin gsal stong zung du 'jug pa dang*/ rlung chos nyid kyi rang bzhin snang stong zung du 'jug pa dang*/ sems bde stong gi zung 'jug byang sems gnyug ma'i gdan bcings pa'o// drug pa la/ rtsa bshad rlung bshad/ rlung ye shes gnyis med du bsre ba/

dmigs pa'i gnad kyi gegs bsal ba/ spang bya spong tshul/ gnyen po ye shes skyes tshul/ phyi nang rtags kyi 'char tshul/ lam skyon lam du blangs pas gegs bsal ba'i gdams ngag /gsum pa gnyis su med pa'i don la ngo sprad pa'i sgo nas las dang skal bar ldan pa'i gang zag gi blo'i padmo kha phye nas de kho na nyid zhen pa'i sgro 'dogs gcod pa la/ bsnyen pa dang*/ sgrub pa gnyis/ dang po la/ zag bcas lus la bde ba ma skyes pa bskyed pa dang*/ skyes pa dbang du bya bas zag med sems kyi bde ba 'char bar byed pa'o// dang po la/ ro ma'i dbab thabs/ rgyal mtshan mtshon bsnun gyi dbab thabs/ yi ge haṃ bcu drug pa'i dbab thabs/ rdo rje sems dpa'i dbab thabs/ gsang yum yid kyi rig ma la brten pa'i dbab thabs/ kun tu rgyus phyag rgya la brten pa'i dbab thabs so// gnyis pa la/ rtsa btsal ba/ dbab pa/ gzung ba/ skyil ba/ bzlog pa/ drangs pa/ bgrams pa/ rjes bcad pa/ bde ba gnad du bsdu ba/ mthar mi nyams shing rgyas par bya'o// gsum pa gtad rgyas de las dgos 'dod kyi bka' bab tshul/ sngon byung

bcu gsum rjes 'jug lung bstan/ ji lta bus gtad pa gsum mo// de la byin gyis brlab 'di don pa/ lung sbyin snod bcud pa rdo rje slob dpon du mchog gi blo can bsko ba/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong dpang du btsugs te gtad/ 'phrin las sgrub pa'i chos skyong bsko ba dang bzhi'o/// /
